card.name: Time words like today and last week
card.fires_on: Words that mark a recent time in news-style text, such as "Today", "last" before week or month, "this" before week, and "Monday" after a past or current event. They come right after a reported event.

modes.label: Today at a start
modes.description: The word Today or TONIGHT opening a title, song or sentence.
modes.example: When you sing “<<Today>> Is Sunday,” Give each child a paper

modes.label: Last week or month
modes.description: The word last after a news event, just before week or month.
modes.example: The Bureau of Labor Statistics released its annual report on union membership<< last>> week.

modes.label: This week or a weekday
modes.description: A time word like this or Monday placed after a verb describing a recent event.
modes.example: Federal offices are closed<< Monday>> because it's Washington's Birthday, a

card.writes: It lowers the chance of today and tonight, so the model is less likely to write those after this spot.
card.plain: It fires on time words like last week or Today in news text and holds back the words today and tonight.
